scope: repository-side HZ canonical RPC ingestion metadata, reorg rollback, deterministic full projection rebuild and failure-path qualification
authoritative_source: canonical EVM chain history and committed manifests
requirements: retain block hash, parent hash, transaction index, transaction hash and log index ordering metadata
do not mark newly indexed blocks finalized unless the canonical source says they are finalized
detect a conflicting block hash at an already indexed event-bearing block
refuse canonical-tail replacement when the conflicting indexed block is finalized
preserve the canonical prefix below the fork block
destructively reset all HZ-derived PostgreSQL projections before replacement-tail replay
route retained canonical events to the correct base, catalog or streaming projector
drop orphaned post-fork events and derived projection state
replay replacement canonical events in deterministic block/transaction/log order
rebuild the complete HZ projection from the retained canonical event journal
produce the exact same complete projection digest after rebuild
reject duplicate event keys, multiple hashes for one supplied block and out-of-order event batches
support JSON-RPC eth_getLogs plus canonical block-header lookup through a decoder boundary
reject removed RPC logs and log/header block-hash disagreement
retain public-testnet endpoint, deployment address and receipt evidence for HZ-AUDIT-7
security_invariants: finalized indexed blocks are not rolled back
failed or invalid canonical batches mutate no projection state before validation
removed RPC logs are not accepted as canonical
RPC log block hashes must match fetched canonical headers
reorg rollback removes orphaned settlement/catalog projection state instead of preserving stale rows

level_2.reason: HZ-AUDIT-5 immediately completed the documented retained 420Hz Level-2 milestone; HZ-AUDIT-6 directly qualifies its indexer integration surface at Level 1 without ceremonial repetition

limitations: the RPC transport accepts a repository-supplied canonical log decoder/enricher; protocol-specific ABI decoding and deployed-address binding are environment wiring owned by HZ-AUDIT-7
indexed_blocks currently records event-bearing blocks rather than every empty chain block; canonical disagreement is detected at indexed event-bearing blocks
projection rebuild is intentionally destructive because chain history remains authoritative
exit_criteria: reorg replacement and full rebuild digest tests pass
finalized-fork and malformed-order negative tests pass
RPC ordering/finality and removed/hash-mismatch tests pass
